author: Francisco Angulo de Lafuente
published_runner_adjustment: The lab checkout directory is read from baseline["cwd"] instead of a hard-coded local path. Workload, generation settings, quality oracles and assessment logic are unchanged.
path_redaction: Local lab and job-work paths are replaced by<LAB> and<RUN> in configuration and logs.
input_provenance: PREREGISTRATION.json records the original pre-execution hashes. Config and runner paths were parameterized for publication; exact exported input hashes are in public-files.json.
training: Both profiles were frozen from the original37requests before the pilot; none of the three new prompts is in that corpus.
profile_scope: A profile orders both GPU-cache entries and the resident RAM tier; timings cannot isolate either tier alone.
outcome: 9of9 correctness gates pass; exact output/token parity fails in clamp. The frozen comparison and improvement gates fail. No speedup claim.
